title: Wrist skin cross-section under a watch (drawn)
depicts: Drawn side cut of the wrist under a smartwatch: skin, tiny vessels that swell per heartbeat, green light going in and back to the sensor.

watch.label: the watch
watch.physical: the watch on the wrist, seen cut through from the side

led.left.label: a green LED
led.left.physical: shines green light into the skin (flashes hundreds of times a second)

led.right.label: a green LED
led.right.physical: shines green light into the skin (flashes hundreds of times a second)

leds.label: the green LEDs
leds.physical: both LEDs on the underside of the watch

sensor.label: the light sensor
sensor.physical: photodiode: measures how much green light comes back

skin.label: your skin
skin.physical: the skin surface under the watch

vessels.label: tiny blood vessels
vessels.physical: vessels in the skin that fill with blood on every heartbeat

vessel.label: a tiny blood vessel
vessel.physical: swells with blood on each heartbeat

light.back.label: green light coming back
light.back.physical: the light that reaches the sensor: less of it while the vessels are full

trace.label: the reading
trace.physical: how much light comes back, over the last few seconds

trace.now.label: the latest reading
trace.now.physical: the newest point of the trace

gap.label: the gap
gap.physical: a loose strap lifts the watch off the skin

ambient.label: room light
ambient.physical: outside light leaking in under the watch
